about: JP-194, the JP-116 run of 20 November: the fixture lacks its Validation section, so triage sends it to the ticket drafter. The drafter's first two attempts write a result in the wrong shape (the model ran, so each uses a run of revise's mid cap of 3), and the third revises. apply_revision applies it and loops back to read_ticket while revise is at its cap. The drafter does not run again (the ready check passes), so the run must not stop at ask_at_limit: it goes on through route and sign-off and the ticket reaches Ready.
